goal.en: Listen to Anna’s journey to work.
goal.zh-Hans: 听懂 Anna 上班方式的变化。

materials.title: When Do I Start? — opening excerpt

blocks.text: Anna: Hi there! Summer in Washington, D.C. is hot and sunny. I always ride the Metro to work. Riding the Metro is cool and fast. But today it’s closed. So, I am walking to work.

explanations.en: Anna does not say cold or snowy.

explanations.zh-Hant: Cool describes riding the Metro, not the weather.

explanations.en: Anna does not mention a bus.

questions.prompt: Why is Anna walking to work today?
